full_judgment:
02. The short facts, for the disposal of this appeal, are that the plaintiff-respondent failed other class Suit No. 135 of 1997 in the court of senior Assistant Judge, sadar, Rajshahi for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession starting, inter alia, that the suit land originally belonged to Adul aziz. S.A khatain No. 810 was pre-pared in his name. He sold the suit land of kazemuddin and other by a registered deed dated 21.01.1963. Kazemuddin got 16 annas shares of the suit land. While he was in possession, R.S. Khaitain No. 395 was correctly prepared in his name. Thereafter, he sold .0350 acre of land from suit plot on 05.10.1983 to one Rabbel Ali who took over possession of the same. The plaintiff purchased .0330 acre by a registered sale deed dated 16.11.1983 from kazemuddin. Rabbel Ali sold .0080 acre of land out of .0350 acre to the plaintiff by a registered deed dated 28.02.1984 and, thus, the plaintiff became owner of .0410 acre of land. He got his name mutated and paid rent to the government. The defendants, claiming title in the suit land, dispossessed him from the same on 15.04.1997 and 22.04.1997. Hence, was the suit. 

 09. It appears from the materials on record that total land appertaining to C.S. khatian No. 891, S.A khatian No. 810, R.S khatian No. 395, S.A. plot No. 4643 is measuring an area of .0812 acre. Admittedly, the said land originally belonged to Kazimuddin. Kazimuddin, on 05.10.1983, transferred .0350 acre of land to Rabbel Ali. Thereafter, he sold .0330 acre of land to plaintiff Alauddin by another sale deed dated 16.11.1983. According to the plaintiff, Robbel Ali sold .0080 acre of land to plaintiff Alauddin by a kabala deed dated 28.02.1984. Thus, the plaintiff acquired title in .0410 acre of land out of the total land of the disputed plot. The plaintiff claimed title in the suit land and prayed for recovery of khas possession in respect of .0080 acre of land out of the total land.
